name: Subverse
summary: Full-budget sci-fi comedy RPG blending twin-stick space shmup combat, grid-based tactical missions, and animated relationship reward scenes.
ranking_rationale: Delivers genuine arcade shooter + tactical RPG gameplay loops alongside polished 3D character animation rather than pure click-through slideshows.

pricing.notes: Check Steam regional pricing (final Complete edition includes all main chapters).

pros: Playable tactical grid combat and twin-stick space battles between story beats
High-budget 3D character models, voice acting, and custom scene viewer
Complete chapter roadmap released on Steam without ongoing live-service fees
cons: Campy space-parody writing isn't for everyone
SHMUP and grid stages get repetitive over back-to-back grinding

facts.value: Sci-fi tactical RPG & adult action game
